explication: Moonshine Voice is an on-device toolkit for real-time voice applications. Its principal workflow accepts live or recorded audio, transcribes it, and exposes transcript events; applications can also synthesize speech, identify speakers, and match spoken phrases by meaning. The graph includes the C/C++ runtime, speech and language-processing capabilities, and available platform entry points. README establishes the major product capabilities; sampled source confirms selected runtime implementations and the WASM worker flow, but not the wiring of every platform or subsystem.
